summary: Thales is french multinational company, founded in 2000. Type: listed company. About 83,020 employees (Wikidata). Revenue Q4916 18.4 billion (2023). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 3 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 1 about acquisitions; 6 about growth or hiring.

culture.text: A huge group with about 83,000 staff in 68 countries, working on defence, aerospace and cyber and digital technology.
Staff often studied electrical engineering or computer science; University of Twente and Saxion are among its top schools.

open.text: Both Thales Nederland and Thales DIS Technologies B.V. are IND recognised sponsors.

growth.text: Staff grew from 68,000 in 2007 to 81,060 in 2023 and 83,020 in 2024.
In 2023 it had revenue of €18,428.4 million and net profit of €1,023.4 million.
Sales reached €20.6 billion in 2024, and it spends over €4 billion a year on R&D.

worth_knowing.text: Ireland ordered Thales Ground Master radars to strengthen its air surveillance, with first deliveries in 2027.
A critical security flaw was reported in Thales SConnect, software used for banking and government authentication.
Its parent is the French state's shareholding agency, and its industries include weapons, aerospace and telecoms.
